description: Géorisques (French portal on natural and technological risks) is a hazard data portal run by French Ministry of Ecological Transition and BRGM. Search summaries describe the portal as the national entry point on natural risks (floods, earthquakes, ground movements, clay shrink-swell, avalanches) and technological risks (hazardous plants, nuclear sites, polluted soils), with 17 databases, downloadable CSV and shapefile files, a REST API and WMS and WFS services. Coverage: France, national coverage. Formats and interfaces named: API, WMS, WFS, CSV, SHP. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the portal page returned a service-unavailable error, so the description, interfaces and formats come from search summaries and public presentations and are unverified; the licence is not known. It can support hazard exposure screening of infrastructure sites and asset portfolios in France. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
